title: Conan and Ebizo's Kabuki Juhachiban Mystery
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Ai Haibara, Inspector Megure, the Detective Boys) omitted by convention, per ep011. IMPORTANT fidelity note: both subtitle files were read in full, but subs_resolved/0805.txt cuts off mid Part 2 right after Conan is pulled out of the collapsing demolition building -- it never reaches the on-stage 'Sleeping Kogoro' reveal scene. Facts needed to close the case that are NOT present in the available transcript (Shioji secretly replacing the real mask with a fake on Hosoo's behalf, Kaneko blackmailing both Iwami and Hosoo with museum photographs, Hosoo's arranged sale of the mask to his client Richard, the exact mechanism of Kaneko's death, and Shioji's final confession to police) were sourced from the episode's wiki page at source_url and are flagged in the relevant node/edge attrs. Everything else (the staged brake sabotage, the mask unveiling, Takahashi's death made to look like a car-interior wipe-down/suicide, Iwami's collapse and hospitalization, Kogoro's on-the-record 'pattern 1/2/3' deduction and his direct accusation of Hosoo, Conan's last outgoing call being to Kaneko, the Ginza alley abduction, the demolition-building rescue) is drawn directly from dialogue. Old cases/ep804-805 file is corrected/expanded on several fronts: it kept event nodes (dropped here, schema v3 uses direct typed edges only); it listed only one crime victim (Hitoshi Takahashi) and omitted that Hosoo also murders Eiji Kaneko to silence him; it used only generic 'knows' edges for every suspect->victim link (replaced here with real typed relationship/employment/blackmail edges); and its single clue (a sleeve button in the engine) is kept but supplemented with two transcript-grounded comparative clues (the wiped-prints inconsistency Kogoro raises on-screen, and his own-logic contact-inconsistency that leads him to directly accuse Hosoo). The old file's murderer_id (Hosoo) is confirmed correct despite the episode's own suspect-list narration naming only Iwami, Kaneko, Yabusaki and Shioji as suspects and never listing Hosoo -- he is framed throughout Part 1 as the apparent target of an attempted murder (the rigged brakes), which is itself his own staged alibi. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Kogoro reasons a legitimate buyback offer for the stolen mask should have gone to Hosoo (its owner), not to Takahashi (the secretary) -- yet Hosoo denies anyone contacted him about it, which is what leads Kogoro to accuse Hosoo directly on the spot.

The van's interior and engine had been wiped completely clean of fingerprints, but someone genuinely committing suicide would have no reason to erase their own prints first -- proves Takahashi's death was staged, not suicide.
